summary.headline: Marcianus Astrological Excerpts
summary.text: Catalog description of a Marcianus astrological manuscript, comparing its excerpts from Paulus, Hephaestion of Thebes, Theophilus, and other ancient authorities with Florentine codices. It records chapters on conjunctions and full moons, zodiacal divisions and natures, inceptions, the month according to Nechepso, and excerpts from Valens, Antiochus, and Rhetorius, including folio correspondences and marginal verses.
